page.overview:
Who is Cianfanelli family?

The Cianfanellis are a family of dwarven bankers who own and operate the Cianfanelli Bank. They have numerous branches throughout the North, as well as in the Nilfgaardian Empire and even one in Zerrikania.

Originally a family of humble traders, everything changed with Amadeus Cianfanelli. He endeavored to establish a successful bank, which he succeeded in. He would go on to found even more branches all over the continent and beyond. Over time, they became among the best bankers on the Continent, alongside the Vivaldis and Giancardis.

Besides their bank, they owned at least one luxurious and exclusive brothel: the Palace of all possibilities, located in Maribor. When the Cianfanellis were persuaded to support the activities of the Wespertyla League, they made the cellars of the brothel available for clandestine meetings. They were persuaded because they stood to profit from a war between Temeria and Redania through potential loans to Temerian troops, as well as by supplying previously prepared transports of weapons and provisions for the army. These plans never came to fruition, as the league was discovered and its members arrested.
